sloka: न ह्यल्पकारणे सुप्तं बोधयिष्यति मां गुरुः ।तदाख्यातार्थतत्त्वेन मत्प्रबोधनकारणम् ।। ६.६०.७१ ।।।।
transliteration: na hyalpakāraṇe suptaṁ bodhayiṣyati māṁ guruḥ ।tadākhyātārthatattvena matprabodhanakāraṇam ।। 6.60.71 ।।।।

translations.english: "O King! there is no danger from Devas. Only a small destruction done by a human is pressing and causing pain."
